parent_objective: audit no-update exact evaluator result before objective-update design
blocked_by: M1619 passes public evaluator gates but does not admit objective update without result audit

public_gates: M1620 must audit M1619 evaluator artifacts and mutation guard
M1620 must decide whether evaluator result admits objective-update design, broader package refresh, another diagnostic, synthesis, pivot, or stop
M1620 must keep training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked during the audit
M1620 must not claim level3 self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not construct an objective config
do not treat evaluator residual as closed-loop proof

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1619 no-update evaluator public pass before deciding next objective route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no optimizer, actor update, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if M1619 evaluator artifacts are missing or nonfinite
stop if diagnostics entered positive objective rows
stop if checkpoint mutation guard failed
stop if evaluator residual is insufficient for any safe objective-update design
fallback_plan: admit objective-update design only if audit accepts metadata/row-metric residual as useful
pivot to action/hidden target materialization if policy-side objective data is missing
pivot to broader candidate refresh if public-overfit risk is too high
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1619 evaluator public pass requires result audit before any objective update

training_stage.stage_objective: audit no-update contour-aware candidate objective evaluator result
admission_evidence: M1619 preserves role integrity and checkpoint mutation guard
blocked_shortcuts: do not construct an objective config
allowed_updates: M1620 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits design, pivot, or stop
next_stage_criteria: supported and unsupported claims are explicit
public-overfit risk and missing policy-side data are addressed

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1620 audits a public package evaluator and cannot strengthen self-ID claims.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If evaluator residual is metadata-only or insufficient for optimization, record the limitation and pivot to action/hidden target materialization or broader source refresh.
allowed_claims: no promotion, objective update, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1619 evaluator artifacts can be audited before any objective-update design or broader route decision.
success_criteria: audit states whether evaluator residual is sufficient for objective-update design
audit records public-overfit and missing policy-side data risks
training PPO promotion private holdout and self-ID claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit ignores role-integrity or mutation-guard failures
audit routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes
audit treats evaluator residual as closed-loop proof
decision_rule: M1620 passes if it audits M1619 and chooses a bounded next route without admitting training/PPO/promotion.
